column3: Hired Thief
Thief Chief
Hired Thief
Another quiet day in Imil.\nThe lighthouse is still\ndark.{end_wait}
Megan and Justin can manage\nwithout me for an hour.\nI needed the air.{end_wait}
That's her. Blue hair,\nhealer's robes. Don't let\nher reach the village.{end_wait}
Excuse me? Are you\nlost?{end_wait}
Not lost. We came for you.\nBe nice and nobody gets\nhurt.{end_wait}
Three men with knives, on\nthe road to my village.\nI won't ask twice.{end_wait}
Useless, the lot of you.\nFine. I'll do it myself.{end_wait}
Keep her busy, kid. Don't\nlet the healer run.{end_wait}
Your men are on the\nground. Walk away.{end_wait}
I don't walk away from\npaid work, girl.{end_wait}
Who sent you?{end_wait}
Nobody. We heard a healer\nwas worth a good ransom.{end_wait}
You knew my hair, my\nrobes, my route. Try\nagain.{end_wait}
...A girl. She came to our\ncamp two nights ago.{end_wait}
She paid in gold, more than\nI've ever held. Half now,\nhalf after.{end_wait}
What did she look like?{end_wait}
Red hair, tied back. Your\nage, maybe a little older.{end_wait}
Cold eyes. She didn't\nblink once while she\ntalked.{end_wait}
Nobody in Imil looks like\nthat. So she isn't from\nImil.{end_wait}
Get up. Take your men and\ngo. If I see you near Imil\nagain, I won't stop.{end_wait}
...Understood.{end_wait}
Not a word to anyone.\nNot yet.{end_wait}
